title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time | TechCrunch
summary: The company’s quarterly revenue crossed $10 billion for the first time, thanks to strong demand for its recent AI models, Bloomberg reported, citing anonymous sources. OpenAI has now reached an annual revenue run rate of $50 billion, according to Bloomberg.
